cohort: The study included 36 pregnant women (12 with pregestational diabetes mellitus, 13 with gestational diabetes mellitus, and 11 controls) and their 26 neonates/children who had follow-up data.
finding: Maternal diabetes is associated with higher neonatal arterial stiffness (specifically in offspring of mothers with PGDM) and increased childhood weight percentile and diastolic blood pressure in the offspring of mothers with diabetes compared to controls.
